<reason>CON made the motion easier to decide by locking the vote to the stated wait, showing 911 cannot pre-sort time-critical crises, and arguing co-response captures de-escalation without that cost. PRO’s “wrong door” and non-caller arguments were sharp but more speculative than CON’s on-the-line waiter, and PRO’s own concessions (uncapped delay; slow team for suicidal talk without a weapon) left the tradeoff looking unjustified.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s unsorted-pool attack, especially converting PRO’s A4.1 dispatch rule into routing delay onto suicidal calls whose danger has not declared itself.</best_rebuttal>
